Name: Shatterfloor
Description: You unleash a thrumming crescendo across a solid surface in a 60-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d6 thunder damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If the surface is made of nonmagical stone, wood, ice, or material with a hardness less than those, the floor is pulverized, becoming difficult terrain.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
